has_proved_result.instructions: Does this checkpoint contain at least one result that is genuinely and unconditionally PROVED within it - an exact computation, an explicit algebraic identity, or a complete derivation - as opposed to a result that depends on an external citation, on another checkpoint, on GRH, on finiteness of Sha, or on a probabilistic heuristic?
criteria: level 0: every substantive claim depends on an external citation, another checkpoint, or an unproved hypothesis
level 1: it contains only routine computations whose correctness is clear but which carry no mathematical content on their own
level 2: it contains a self-contained exact computation or algebraic identity that would be reusable if verified
level 3: it contains a complete self-contained derivation of a non-trivial statement, proved within the checkpoint itself

reusable_elsewhere.instructions: Would the self-contained part of this checkpoint remain valid and useful even if the checkpoint's headline conclusion were withdrawn?

criteria.true: it establishes an identity, a valuation profile, a conductor computation, a class-group fact or a point count that stands on its own
criteria.false: everything in it is downstream of the headline claim and falls with it
